target_customer: Fashion e-commerce retailers and fashion creators
problem: Online shoppers cannot see how garments look on a body; retailers rely on 3D modeling or manual image edits.
business_model: B2B API and SaaS for virtual try-on, plus fashion design tools

founders.name: Kedan Li
education: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, PhD candidate
founders.background_notes: YC page: researcher at Pinterest, engineer at Fitbit.

founders.name: Min Jin Chong
education: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, PhD in computer vision

founders.name: Jeffrey Zhang
education: PhD candidate in AI and computer vision
founders.background_notes: YC page; TechCrunch names all three as co-founders and PhD students.

technical_complexity.rationale: Image based virtual try-on with 2D inputs was a research problem; the founders were computer vision PhD students.

defensibility.rationale: Specialized models and research talent, but the field moved quickly toward generative models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced; no incumbent acquisition of Revery found.

market_need_then: TechCrunch August 2021 reports customers including Zalora and talks with over 40 retailers; the YC page claims about 1 million dollars ARR, self-reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses revery.ai; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pitched as TikTok for fashion on the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: TechCrunch and NVIDIA blog coverage, but no brand-specific press found.

pivots.from: B2B virtual dressing room for retailers
pivots.to: TikTok for fashion with design and try-on tools
pivots.why: Reframing shown on the YC page; the date and reason are not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Revery AI had strong research founders, retailer pilots and a YC plus seed raise in 2021, but the directory marks it Inactive while later product pages still show a try-on API. The cause of inactivity is not public and may reflect a directory status error.
notes: revery.ai did not resolve in this session network. Funding sources conflict: 125K YC, a Diffbot seed of 1.225M, CB Insights total 1.33M over 4 rounds, Caplight 2.5M; the October 2021 seed rests on one database and its amount is null. TechCrunch names no competitors, only rivals using 3D modeling, so the list is empty. Status Inactive conflicts with a later try-on API product page.
